title: Psalms 124
paragraphs: ¹ If the LORD had not been on our side — let Israel say — ² if the LORD had not been on our side when people rose against us, ³ they would have swallowed us alive when their anger blazed against us; ⁴ the flood would have overwhelmed us, the torrent would have swept over us; ⁵ the raging waters would have swept over us.

⁶ Praise be to the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth. ⁷ We have escaped like a bird from the fowler's snare; the snare is broken, and we have escaped. ⁸ Our help is in the name of the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.
